correctness.rationale: For any two query edges ab,ac of simple G, a maximal clique containing both is either contained in the common-vertex star or the triangle abc, so at most two maximal cliques contain both. A depth-4 complete Littlestone mistake tree would need at least four hypotheses answering both first two branch queries positively, a contradiction. On K_n, n≥4, maximal cliques are all n full stars and C(n,3) triangles; explicit traces realize all patterns on pairwise-intersecting triple supports, while disjoint edges and size-four supports cannot be shattered. Exact polynomial follows from counting nC(n−1,3) star triples and C(n,3) triangle triples. Independent exhaustive small-graph calculation reconstructed K4 counts (1,6,12,8), K5 counts (1,10,30,30), and confirmed the combinatorial claim.
residual_risks: Universal bound is proved structurally, not by finite enumeration; no exact Ldim formula for every individual graph.

originality.rationale: The 2026-11-08 published result Exact shattering and online learning for maximal intersecting edge families proves the identical K_n maximal-family shattering characterization, all coefficients, and VCdim=Ldim=3. Its apparently narrower K_n theorem ALSO IMPLIES the submitted new-looking all-simple-G upper bound: embed V(G) in [N] with N=max(4,|V(G)|); every inclusion-maximal pairwise-intersecting edge family in G is either a full G-star (possibly a singleton at a leaf) or a G-triangle, and is therefore the trace on E(G) of a maximal star/triangle family of K_N. Thus C(G) is a subset of the domain restriction of C(K_N); Littlestone and VC dimensions cannot increase under restricting the query domain or deleting concepts. The previously proved Ldim(C(K_N))=3 therefore already yields Ldim(C(G))≤3 for all G. The entire final theorem is covered under a natural projection/reduction, even though the prior title mentions only K_n.
residual_risks: Both publications bear date 2026-11-08; no intra-day first-public priority is fabricated. Classification is by presently published mathematical implication, not chronology or identical titles.

value.rationale: A uniform adaptive learning bound for maximal cliques is a natural structural fact about a graph class, with an exact complete-graph shattering polynomial and sharp worst-case dimension. The invariant has clear application to online membership learning. It is nevertheless already implied by the published K_n concept theorem through a standard trace argument; mathematical utility is distinct from originality.
residual_risks: Same-day publications do not prove precedence; the mathematical theorem is covered independent of chronology.

final_claim: For every finite simple graph G, the maximal-clique membership concept class of L(G) has VC and Littlestone dimension at most three; for K_n,n≥4, both are three with polynomial 1+C(n,2)z+3C(n,3)z²+[C(n,3)+nC(n−1,3)]z³.
limitations: Simple graphs only; empty-edge convention dimension zero; no individual-graph exact formula claimed.
